tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Use when you already have the URL of a specific public page and need its readable text — not for searching, crawling a site, or reaching anything behind a login. Fetches one public web page and returns it as clean markdown with its title, byline, language, word count and a SHA-256 of the output. Obe
